verdict.rationale: Docs show Copilot can run multiple background cloud-agent sessions in parallel, track them from one control page, and trigger automations on repo events/schedules (docs-8, docs-14, docs-15, docs-33), which supports scaling to many tasks, but there's no explicit evidence of a single bulk command/batch operation (e.g., 'review 50 PRs at once' or 'fix all issues matching X') as a discrete feature. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-action UI/API (e.g., batch PR review, batch issue triage) and independent confirmation that many items can be processed in one invocation rather than via separate parallel agent sessions.
